name: Nova Data - Adiel - Jan 22
description: Techno DJ Adiel performs at Switch in Porto on 22 January 2027.
longDescription:
Italian techno artist Adiel performs a set at Switch club in Porto. The night runs from 11:00 PM until 6:00 AM.

The venue is located at Rua de Júlio Dinis 766. Tickets start at €10.00 for early bird admission and rise to €15.00.
descriptionPt: A DJ de techno Adiel atua no Switch, no Porto, a 22 de janeiro de 2027.
longDescriptionPt:
A artista italiana de techno Adiel apresenta um set no clube Switch, no Porto. A noite decorre entre as 23h00 e as 06h00.

O espaço fica na Rua de Júlio Dinis, 766. Os bilhetes custam entre 10,00€ (early bird) e 15,00€.
